title: FOI 2.0 – Impact of Virtual Reality Simulator Training on Awake Fiberoptic Intubation Performance: A Randomized Controlled Trial
summary:
Airway management is an essential part of anesthesia, intensive care, and emergency medicine. In patients with a difficult airway, a specialized technique called fiberoptic intubation is often used to safely place a breathing tube. As this procedure is performed less frequently in daily clinical practice, modern training methods are becoming increasingly important.

The aim of this study is to investigate whether training with a virtual reality simulator can improve physicians' skills in performing fiberoptic intubation.
conditions: Difficult Airway Management: Awake Fiberoptic Intubation
